typography.headings: Clash Display (magazine-editorial scale, clamped sizes, tight line-height)
typography.accents: Fraunces (italic serif, used for words like 'Financial')
typography.mono: JetBrains Mono (terminal data, labels, tickers, small caps)

colors.strategy: Retain existing CSS variables. Use for sharp, high-contrast, editorial aesthetics.

visual enhancers.overlays: Apply a subtle CRT/terminal grain overlay at ~4% opacity across the above-the-fold zone.
visual enhancers.grids: Introduce a 1px dot-matrix/graph-paper grid background at ~6% opacity to thread sections together.
visual enhancers.borders: Use sharp 1px borders for cards and sections. Avoid rounded pillowy glows.
visual enhancers.backgrounds: Remove 3D glowing blobs and orbital ellipses. Add faint, static SVG finance charts (candlestick/line).

grids: 12-column editorial grid for main layouts (e.g., Hero: 7 cols left, 4 cols right, 1 col gutter). 3-column grids for cards.

layouts.Navbar: Add top thin status bar (Bloomberg-style): 'NSE +0.42% · BSE +0.38% · USD/INR 83.21 · Last updated 12:34 IST' with mono type, ~24px tall. Nav links: JetBrains Mono uppercase small caps. Add underline-on-hover effect. Free Mock: Keep pink pulse dot restrained to 4px. Sign up: Sharper corners, mono label. Header background: Must be semi-solid or glassmorphic, NO fully transparent background.
layouts.HeroSection: 12-column grid. Left side (7 cols): Text content. H1 clamped size (magazine scale), 'Financial' in italic serif with colored underline. Primary CTA: Sharp pill/squared button, mono cap label. Secondary: Text link with leading arrow. Trust strip: Mono uppercase with pipe dividers. Right side (4 cols): Roadmap panel redesigned as Bloomberg terminal panel. Mono uppercase header ('ROADMAP // STUDENT PATH'), 1px sharp corners, 'LIVE' dot, numeric mono readout progress bar. Bottom: Slow horizontal marquee ticker with static dummy data.
layouts.ProblemSection: Add a stripe of mono caption above the title ('PROBLEM // MARKET GAP'). Add a mono chapter label ('§01 // PROGRAM'). Cards: 3-column editorial grid. Sharp corners, thin 1px borders. Add numeric prefix ('01 / NO CLEAR ROADMAP') in mono. Frame lucide-react icons in a bordered square with a mono label ('01 · ROADMAP'). No colored gradient washes.

motion.restraint: Strict restraint. No parallax, no blinking cursor, no blob animations.
motion.allowed: Sparkline gentle drift, ticker slow horizontal marquee, staggered fade-in of copy on mount.

accessibility.contrast: Maintain high contrast ratios (APCA/WCAG). Use Text Shadow where needed if text is over terminal grids.
accessibility.data_testid: Preserve all existing data-testid attributes perfectly. All interactive elements MUST have a data-testid.

media: Static dummy data and SVG charts only.
3d libraries: Keep LandingHero3D/ProblemAssemblyScene but dial back opacity significantly. Ensure it doesn't compete with text.
instructions_to_main_agent: DO NOT change any text copy. Use exact strings provided in the existing files.
DO NOT introduce new fonts or color tokens. Use existing CSS variables.
DO NOT break existing routing or Links.
DO NOT touch the mobile menu overlay layout.
Apply the redesign focusing on 1440x900 and 1920x1080 laptop layouts.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic centered layouts. Use grid-based left-aligned typography.
Use generous spacing (p-8, p-12) within constrained grid columns.
Never apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific transition properties.
Do not use complete transparent background in headers, overlays, or surfaces containing content.
Always use specific, sharp button styles rather than generic soft rounded blobs.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
